{{Quote|The Star Destroyer ''Immortal'' is out to capture Princess Leia's Corvette.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]]|<ref name="XW" />|audio=AckbarImmortalLeia-XW.flac}}
The [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Immortal/Legends|''Immortal'']] launched an '''assault''' on the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] in an attempt to recover stolen [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]] to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].

==Prelude==
Using [[Ambush of the Phoenix|stolen]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[communications satellite]]s, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] acquired [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]] to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. These were [[Death Star plans delivery|delivered]] to [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] aboard the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], which was to carry them to [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]]. The delivery of the plans was intercepted by the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Immortal/Legends|''Immortal'']], but the ''Tantive IV'' narrowly escaped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] with the help of Rebel [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] from the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|Independence]].<ref name="XW" />

==The battle==
The ''Tantive IV'' reverted to [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]]<ref name="XW" /> an hour later,<ref name="OSG" /> and Organa planned to transfer to he waiting Mon Calamari Star Cruiser [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']]. However, the transfer came under attack from the ''Immortal'', as the Imperials attempted to recover the plans, and the ''Tantive IV'' was forced to flee.<ref name="XW" /> The ''Independence'' responded quickly,<ref name="OSG" /> sending two [[R-22 Spearhead starfighter|R-22 Spearheads]]<ref name="R22" /> from [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] to assist, along with two [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] from [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]].<ref name="XW" />

The Rebel R-22s moved to [[Starfighter combat/Legends|intercept]] [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bombers]] launched from the ''Immortal'', leaving the X-wings to target Imperial [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptors]]. Imperial reinforcements soon arrived in the form of [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] from [[Tau Squadron]], but the R-22s used their [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]] to quickly finish off the TIE bombers, before engaging the new threat. The ''Immortal'' launched additional TIE bombers, but they were unable to reach the ''Tantive IV'' before it once more escaped into hyperspace. The other Rebel ships withdrew after clearing the remaining Imperial starfighters.<ref name="XW" />

==Aftermath==
The ''Tantive IV''{{'s}} escape was short-lived. As the [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]] celebrated aboard the ''Independence'', they learned that the ''Tantive IV'' had been ambushed again after exiting hyperspace.<ref name="OSG" /> The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|captured]] near [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], but Organa ensured that the plans did not fall into Imperial hands, sending them to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The battle first appeared in the [[1993]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']], in the final mission of "Tour of Duty II: The Great Search", "Protect Princess Leia."<ref name="XW" />
